name: John & Eva - Traveling in Jogjakarta
source:
The story is about John and Eva, a couple of travelers from Australia. They love to travel to new places.
This time, John and Eva decided to travel to Jogjakarta, Indonesia. They found many interesting places such as Malioboro, Beringharjo Market, Keraton, and Borobudur Temple. They also rode on some traditional transportations and tasted the local food from Jogjakarta.
Hmm, how's their travel? Join them in "John and Eva - Traveling in Jogjakarta".

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908163833/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.imagin.johnevajken&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述的是一对来自澳大利亚的旅行者约翰和伊娃。他们喜欢去新的地方旅行。
这次，约翰和伊娃决定前往印度尼西亚日惹。他们发现了许多有趣的地方，如Malioboro、Beringharjo Market、Keraton和Borobudur Temple。他们还乘坐了一些传统交通工具，品尝了日惹当地的美食。
嗯，他们的旅行怎么样？与他们一起参加“约翰和伊娃 - 日惹之旅”。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908163833/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.imagin.johnevajken&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
